figurative_meaning_en: behind the scenes or unnoticed; secretly
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সকল কার্যকলাপ নেপথ্যে পরিচালিত হয়।
নেপথ্যে কাজ করে সে প্রকাশ্যে সাফল্য পায়।
example_sentences_in_english: All his activities are conducted behind the scenes.
He works in secret to achieve public success.
note: Derived from theatrical term 'nepothyo' meaning backstage, commonly used in Bengali to denote concealed activities.
